name: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic
summary: High Sorcerer Andromath seeks Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic in Stormwind. Morganth stole the forbidden tome and carried it to the Tower of Ilgalar in the Redridge Mountains.

sections.title: A Schism in the Tower
sections.body: Three promising mages studied together in Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum. Morganth turned to dark arts and shadow magic despite their desperate warnings. The city's magical order banished him. Before he left, he stole a dangerous work by Ur, an infamous archmage whose studies reached beyond orthodox arcana.

sections.title: The Fallen Mage's Lair
sections.body: Morganth seized the Tower of Ilgalar in the heights of the Redridge Mountains, beyond Stormwind's scrutiny. High Sorcerer Andromath fears the tome's knowledge in the hands of an outcast practicing forbidden sorcery. So he sends Alliance adventurers into the tower to recover it before its wards fall.

sections.title: Intact Wards
sections.body: Ur's treatise returned to the Wizard's Sanctum with its protective enchantments intact. High Sorcerer Andromath is greatly relieved. He feared Morganth had unraveled the wards or hidden the book beyond reach. The seals held firm, keeping the catastrophic secrets in its pages from the rogue sorcerer.

faq.answer: Ur wrote the treatise. The legendary Dalaran mage was renowned for esoteric research into extra-planar entities and shadow magic.

faq.q: Who stole Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic?
faq.answer: Morganth stole Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic. He was a Stormwind mage who turned to dark magic and was banished from the Wizard's Sanctum.
The book is in the library of the Tower of Ilgalar, high in the Redridge Mountains, where Morganth established his new sanctuary.

faq.q: Did Morganth manage to read the book?
faq.answer: No. High Sorcerer Andromath confirms that the book's protective seals held firm when it was returned, so Morganth never opened it.

faq.q: Why do the mages of Stormwind want the book back?
faq.answer: Stormwind's mages want the book back because its profound secrets of shadow magic can bring ruin to the untrained. They fear leaving it with Morganth, an outcast practicing forbidden sorcery.

aliases: where to get urs treatise quest
faq.answer: High Sorcerer Andromath gives it from the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

angles.text: As a mage, you see how seriously Stormwind's mages take discipline within their order. They entrust you with containing the danger left by a peer who turned to forbidden shadow magic.
As a warlock, you may covet the powers of extra-planar summoning and dark casting sealed in Ur's treatises. The Kirin Tor and Stormwind's mages fear those powers.
As an Alliance member, you help protect Redridge from Morganth's growing magical menace and Stormwind from rogue arcana by recovering the stolen tome.
